proof_origin.place: Tag 070S(2) and Tag 03FH(1); explicit Lean assembly by V2, 2026-10-13, through local module lifting, the canonical open-section comparison and the sheafified kernel lift.

title: Exactness of tensor sections at a module cokernel
statement: For a module morphism φ : F ⟶ G and its cokernel projection, the sheafified ULift tensor-section sequence is exact at the middle term. The module category is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], X is [def-pc-scheme], and the normalized tensor-section presheaves are [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. The given natural transformations are required to have exactly the tensor-pullback maps as components; they are not arbitrary morphisms. The equation w states that the induced consecutive sheaf maps compose to zero. The conclusion asserts only exactness, with no epimorphism assertion.

proof.text: For each etale object U, use [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] to make tensorPullback U.hom a left adjoint and additive functor. The canonical module cokernel complex is exact. Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel transports its exactness to U.Modules. Apply the exactness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-module-exactness-local-lifting] to a global section killed by the pulled-back cokernel map to obtain a Zariski covering and local preimages.

Use the explicitly constructed tensorOpenSectionIso of [new-etale-tensor-open-section-iso]. Its naturality in module morphisms follows by leftAdjointUniq naturality and ordinary presheaf naturality. Its compatibility with the global-section unit follows from Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app and restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app. For each covering open W of U, compose the inverse of tensorSectionsComp(W.ι,U.hom) on global sections with this isomorphism. The composition and restriction definitions in [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] show that this comparison takes the etale restriction to the ordinary restriction on U, and is natural in the module morphism. Transport each local preimage through its inverse. The image sieve contains the covering sieve of these open immersions, which is covering by Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff.

The cokernel condition and preservation of zero morphisms give alpha composed with beta equal to zero. Universe lifting does not change the image sieve: lower a lifted preimage, or lift an ordinary preimage. For the lifted complex, let l be kernel.lift beta alpha. The kernel inclusion has injective components; its naturality identifies local lifts through alpha with local lifts through l. Thus l is locally surjective. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_iff and Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective make its sheafification epic. Sheafification preserves kernels, so its kernelComparison is invertible; map_lift_kernelComparison identifies its composite with the kernel lift of the sheafified complex. ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift proves the conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleTensorSections_cokernel_exact {X : Scheme.{u}} {F G : X.Modules}
    (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (α : etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf F ⟶ etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf G)
    (β : etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf G ⟶ etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf (cokernel φ))
    (hα : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ, α.app U = ((tensorPullback U.unop.hom).map φ).app ⊤)
    (hβ : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ,
      β.app U = ((tensorPullback U.unop.hom).map (cokernel.π φ)).app ⊤)
    (w : ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight α AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u})) ≫
      ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight β AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u})) = 0) :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight α AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}))
      ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight β AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u})) w).Exact
